title: Copper Tundra: The Machinist's Aurora Register
premise: In a magnetized polar steppe threaded by buried power rails, the machinist must rebalance a failing mechanical relay using a portable phase regulator.
ending: Recover the Aurora Register and return with the stable field relay; Polar Surveyors can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive conductive frost while evading the rail colossus without sacrificing the stable field relay.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Polar Surveyors to witness the portable phase regulator.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to divert power from a shelter
